declarations.name: AuiTour

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The steps: { id, title, content?, target?, placement?, spotlightPadding?, onBeforeShow? }. target is an Element, a CSS selector, a function returning an Element, or null for a centered step.

inputs.name: dots
inputs.description: Show decorative progress dots under the content.

inputs.name: skippable
inputs.description: Show the Skip button (hidden on the last step).

inputs.name: keyboardNavigation
inputs.description: Arrow keys move between steps while focus is on the panel or its buttons (mirrored in RTL).

inputs.name: modal
inputs.description: Each step is a modal dialog: focus is trapped and the page is blocked.

inputs.name: spotlight
inputs.description: Dim the page around the target.

inputs.name: spotlightPadding
inputs.description: Space between the target and the spotlight edge, px (0 to 64).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the button labels and progress text.

outputs.name: started
outputs.description: The tour started: { index } of the first shown step.

outputs.name: stepChange
outputs.description: A step is shown: { index, stepId, previousIndex, direction }.

outputs.name: stepMissing
outputs.description: A step was skipped because its target is missing, hidden, or its hook failed: { index, stepId, reason }.

outputs.name: finished
outputs.description: The tour ended at its end: { index, completed } (completed is false when no later step could be shown).

outputs.name: skipped
outputs.description: The tour was skipped: { index, stepId, reason }.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Start (or restart) at index (default 0); steps with a missing target are skipped.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Show the next available step; on the last step, finish.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show the step at index (starts the tour when inactive).

methods.name: skip
methods.description: End the tour early and emit aui-skip.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: End the tour as completed and emit aui-finish.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Dialog per step: a non-modal dialog by default (the page stays usable), or a modal dialog with aria-modal and a focus trap. Focus moves to the step dialog on every step and returns to the element that had focus before the tour.

limitations: One target per step; the spotlight is a rounded rectangle around it.
In modal mode the spotlighted element is shown but not interactive.
Targets inside closed shadow roots or other documents (iframes) cannot be found by selector; pass a function that returns the element.
